title: PurchaseWindowRequest

ownerOrganisationId.description: Internal id of the organisation that owns this element. Omit it to use the organisation in the access token, which is what a caller acting for itself should do. Supplying a different organisation requires permission to act on behalf of that organisation.

startDate.description: First day this purchase window version is valid.

endDate.description: Last day this purchase window version is valid (optional). Omit for an open-ended version.

allOf.description:
Status of the purchase window version. Required; on create only DRAFT or
PROPOSED is accepted — a new version cannot be published directly.

When a purchase can be made relative to the time of travel. Optional: when omitted, the
purchase window sets no restriction on when the purchase can be made, only the periods
before departure (if set) apply.

latestTime.description: Latest time of day a purchase can be made (NeTEx `LatestTime`), formatted `HH:mm:ss`.

minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture.description:
Minimum period before departure that a purchase must be made (NeTEx
`MinimumPeriodBeforeDeparture`). ISO 8601 duration with days, hours, minutes and/or seconds.

maximumPeriodBeforeDeparture.description:
Maximum period before departure that a purchase can be made (NeTEx
`MaximumPeriodBeforeDeparture`). ISO 8601 duration with days, hours, minutes and/or seconds.
Must not be shorter than `minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture`.

allOf.description: The purchase action this window applies to (NeTEx `PurchaseAction`).

purchaseMoments.description: The moments at which a purchase can be made (NeTEx `PurchaseMoment`, a list).

value.description: The localized string value for the specified lang.

PurchaseAction.description: The type of purchase action the window applies to.

PurchaseMoment.description: A moment at which a purchase can be made.

PurchaseWhen.description:
When a purchase can be made relative to the time of travel.

- **ADVANCE_ONLY** - Only in advance of the day of travel.
- **UNTIL_PREVIOUS_DAY** - Until the end of the day before travel.
- **DAY_OF_TRAVEL_ONLY** - Only on the day of travel.
- **ADVANCE_AND_DAY_OF_TRAVEL** - In advance or on the day of travel.
- **TIME_OF_TRAVEL_ONLY** - Only at the time of travel.
- **SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGE_MOMENT** - At the charge moment of a subscription.
- **OTHER** - Other rule.
